description: This file contains Perl code implementing optimized Montgomery multiplication routines for x86_64 architecture, including functions for multiplication, squaring, and specialized variants with loop unrolling and CPU feature detection. It also includes exception handling code for Windows 64-bit systems.

methods.name: bn_mul_mont
methods.description: Performs Montgomery multiplication for large integers, optimized for x86_64, with support for loop unrolling and CPU feature detection.

methods.name: bn_mul4x_mont
methods.description: Optimized 4x loop unrolled Montgomery multiplication routine.

methods.name: bn_sqr8x_mont
methods.description: Optimized 8x loop unrolled Montgomery squaring routine.

methods.name: bn_mulx4x_mont
methods.description: Further optimized Montgomery multiplication with advanced CPU feature support.
